name: helper-source-folders
goal: Public helpers live under src/helpers/<responsibility> and helper Source tabs show only the selected callable implementation; owner-private helpers stay with owners

evidence: Pre-existing mixed helper/module ownership survived71 structural moves. Humanize was defined under utils but its module owned component contract code; helperEntity narrowed owns.source but retained all archived sourceFiles.

Existing Source fixture had one effective source per helper and no selected-helper archive assertion. Registry checked examples but not canonical helper ownership. Pieces test allowed helper classes. Extended these standard checks and generated-project guidance coverage.
